main:anemos.summary: Launches a player-owned wind charge when the weapon strikes a target or block.
main:anemos.activation: On attack or block hit while held in the main hand.

main:bloodrage.summary: Grants Resistance II and Strength I while the wearer is at 10 health points or less.
main:bloodrage.activation: Checked continuously while the enchanted item is held.

main:cleanse_armor_head.activation: While the associated armor is equipped.

main:cleanse_armor_chest.activation: While the associated armor is equipped.

main:cleanse_armor_legs.activation: While the associated armor is equipped.

main:cleanse_armor_feet.activation: While the associated armor is equipped.

main:cleanse_armor_maleffect.summary: Continuously removes Poison, Wither, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, Blindness, Darkness, Infested, Weaving, Nausea, Oozing, and Slowness.
main:cleanse_armor_maleffect.activation: While the associated armor is equipped.

main:conduit_power.summary: Continuously grants Conduit Power I and Dolphin's Grace I.
main:conduit_power.activation: While worn in the head slot.

main:divinity.summary: Periodically grants Absorption based on the number of equipped Divinity items.
main:divinity.activation: Counts enchanted armor and the held main-hand item.
main:divinity.scaling: One piece grants Absorption I, two grant II, three grant III, and four grant V with a faster 20-second refresh.

main:fire_proof.activation: While worn in the head slot.

main:freezing_protection.activation: When receiving damage tagged as freezing.
main:freezing_protection.scaling: Adds 24 protection per level, up to level III.

main:haste.activation: While worn in the head slot.

main:magic_protection.summary: Adds protection against damage tagged as magic.
main:magic_protection.activation: When receiving magic damage while the associated armor is equipped.

main:max_magic_protection.summary: Provides the maximum variant of protection against magic damage.
main:max_magic_protection.activation: When receiving magic damage while the associated armor is equipped.

main:reach.activation: While worn in the chest slot.
main:reach.scaling: Adds 2 blocks per level, up to level III.

main:regeneration.summary: Applies recurring Regeneration I when Regeneration is not already active.
main:regeneration.activation: Checked continuously while worn in the head slot.
main:regeneration.scaling: Single level; each application lasts 3 seconds.

main:riposte.summary: Propels the attacker backward after a successful attack and consumes one durability.
main:riposte.activation: After attacking while not riding, fall-flying, or in water.
main:riposte.scaling: Impulse strength increases by 0.458 per level, up to level III.

main:sanguine.summary: Grants Regeneration III for one second after attacking a valid target.
main:sanguine.activation: After attacking anything except an armor stand.

main:shakudo_regen.summary: Periodically grants Regeneration based on the number of equipped Shakudo pieces.
main:shakudo_regen.activation: Counts enchanted armor pieces and compatible held equipment.
main:shakudo_regen.scaling: More pieces shorten the interval; five or more pieces increase the effect to Regeneration II.

main:slaughter.summary: Deals 40 additional damage to livestock and heavily slows nearby livestock.
main:slaughter.activation: On damage and continuously while held in the main hand.

main:traversal.summary: Increases movement speed while traveling over paths, gravel, coarse dirt, packed mud, or mud bricks.
main:traversal.activation: While moving on supported surfaces and not flying or riding.
main:traversal.scaling: Adds 0.0105 movement speed per level, up to level III, with a 4 percent per-level durability-use chance.

main:warding_armour.summary: Combines equipped warding armor pieces to slow and damage nearby warding targets.
main:warding_armour.activation: Checked continuously while warding armor is equipped.
main:warding_armour.scaling: Range, damage, refresh speed, and anti-copper behavior improve with additional pieces.

main:warding0.summary: Slows warding targets within 8 blocks and damages nearby non-Wither targets within 3 blocks.

main:warding1.summary: Slows warding targets within 8 blocks, damages non-Wither targets within 6 blocks, and damages Withers within 8 blocks.

main:warding2.summary: Slows warding targets within 14 blocks, damages non-Wither targets within 8 blocks, and damages Withers within 12 blocks.

main:warding3.summary: Slows warding targets within 24 blocks and applies stronger damage at extended ranges, including against Withers.
main:warding3.scaling: Maximum warding tier with special behavior against targets wearing copper armor.

main:zephyr.summary: Supports a charged wind-assisted launch using Jump Boost, Slow Falling, particles, and a wind burst.
main:zephyr.activation: Charge by sneaking, then release while airborne.
